words.definition: A competition in which many players or teams compete against each other to win.
words.example_en: Our school won the football tournament last year.
words.example_sk: Naša škola minulý rok vyhrala futbalový turnaj.

words.definition: A person who trains, guides, or instructs someone in a sport, skill, or personal development; also a large comfortable bus used for longer journeys.
words.example_en: Her coach helped her prepare for the competition.
words.example_sk: Jej tréner jej pomohol pripraviť sa na súťaž.

words.definition: Physically strong, fit, and good at sports or physical exercise.
words.example_en: She is very athletic and plays several sports.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi športovo založená a hrá niekoľko športov.

words.definition: To try to win or be more successful than others in a game, activity, or situation.
words.example_en: Athletes from many countries compete in the Olympic Games.
words.example_sk: Športovci z mnohých krajín súťažia na Olympijských hrách.

words.definition: A board or screen that shows the score in a game or competition.
words.example_en: The scoreboard showed that the home team was winning.
words.example_sk: Tabuľa so skóre ukazovala, že domáci tím vyhráva.

words.definition: To prepare your body or mind for exercise, sport, or another activity; also the activity of preparing in this way.
words.example_en: Always warm up before you start running.
words.example_sk: Predtým, než začneš behať, sa vždy rozcvič.

words.definition: A person who watches an event, show, or activity.
words.example_en: Thousands of spectators watched the football match.
words.example_sk: Tisíce divákov sledovali futbalový zápas.

words.definition: At a fast speed or in a short time.
words.example_en: She finished her homework quickly.
words.example_sk: Rýchlo dokončila domácu úlohu.

words.definition: The act of protecting someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism.
words.example_en: The team worked hard in defense throughout the game.
words.example_sk: Tím počas celého zápasu tvrdo pracoval v obrane.

words.definition: The process of learning the skills needed for a particular job, activity, or sport through practice and instruction.
words.example_en: She attends training every morning before work.
words.example_sk: Každé ráno pred prácou chodí na tréning.

words.definition: A person who makes sure that players follow the rules in a game or sport.
words.example_en: The referee stopped the match after the foul.
words.example_sk: Rozhodca prerušil zápas po faule.

words.definition: Repeated activity done to improve a skill, or the act of doing something regularly; also, to do something repeatedly to get better at it.
words.example_en: You need practice to play the piano well.
words.example_sk: Potrebuješ cvičenie, aby si vedel dobre hrať na klavíri.

words.definition: The combined effort of a group of people working together to achieve a common goal.
words.example_en: Good teamwork can help a project succeed.
words.example_sk: Dobrá tímová práca môže pomôcť projektu uspieť.

words.definition: The physical or mental strength to continue doing something for a long time.
words.example_en: Running a marathon requires a lot of stamina.
words.example_sk: Bežať maratón si vyžaduje veľkú výdrž.

words.definition: A number of points, goals, or marks achieved in a game, test, or competition; also, to gain points or to mark and evaluate something.
words.example_en: Our team got a high score in the match.
words.example_sk: Náš tím získal v zápase vysoké skóre.

words.definition: Wanting to be more successful than others; involving competition.
words.example_en: She is very competitive and always wants to win.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi súťaživá a vždy chce vyhrať.

words.definition: In a way that gives close attention to detail or avoids harm, mistakes, or risk.
words.example_en: She carefully opened the fragile box.
words.example_sk: Opatrne otvorila krehkú škatuľu.

words.definition: To solve something, to end successfully, or to exercise.
words.example_en: We need to work out the problem before the meeting.
words.example_sk: Musíme vyriešiť problém pred stretnutím.

words.definition: A person who is in charge of a ship, aircraft, sports team, or a group of people.
words.example_en: The captain led the team to victory.
words.example_sk: Kapitán doviedol tím k víťazstvu.

words.definition: Success in a competition, battle, or struggle; the act of winning.
words.example_en: The team celebrated its victory after the final match.
words.example_sk: Tím oslavoval svoje víťazstvo po finálovom zápase.

words.definition: A competition or series of contests to determine the best player or team in a sport or activity.
words.example_en: Their team won the national championship last year.
words.example_sk: Ich tím minulý rok vyhral národný šampionát.

words.definition: A person who teaches, coaches, or prepares someone for a sport, job, or activity.
words.example_en: The trainer helped the team improve their fitness.
words.example_sk: Tréner pomohol tímu zlepšiť si kondíciu.

words.definition: To be the right size or shape for something or someone; also, to be healthy and in good physical condition.
words.example_en: These shoes fit me perfectly, and I feel fit enough to run every morning.
words.example_sk: Tieto topánky mi perfektne sedia a cítim sa dosť fit na to, aby som každé ráno behal.

words.definition: To run at a slow, steady pace, usually for exercise.
words.example_en: I jog in the park every morning.
words.example_sk: Každé ráno si ľahko zabehnem v parku.

words.definition: The player in sports such as football or hockey whose job is to stop the ball or puck from going into the goal.
words.example_en: The goalkeeper made an excellent save in the final minute.
words.example_sk: Brankár predviedol v poslednej minúte vynikajúci zákrok.

words.definition: Honest and respectful behavior, especially when competing or following rules.
words.example_en: The referee praised both teams for their fair play.
words.example_sk: Rozhodca pochválil oba tímy za ich čestnú hru.

words.definition: At the same time or in the same way over and over again; often.
words.example_en: She exercises regularly to stay healthy.
words.example_sk: Pravidelne cvičí, aby zostala zdravá.

words.definition: A contest between two or more players or teams; something that is equal or similar to another; a small stick used to make fire; to be similar or equal to something, or to go well with it.
words.example_en: This shirt matches your shoes, and we watched a football match afterward.
words.example_sk: Táto košeľa sa hodí k tvojim topánkam a potom sme pozerali futbalový zápas.

words.definition: Having or showing a lot of energy and enthusiasm.
words.example_en: She is an energetic teacher who keeps the class active.
words.example_sk: Je to energická učiteľka, ktorá udržiava triedu aktívnu.

words.definition: To make something longer, wider, or looser by pulling it; also, a continuous area or period of time.
words.example_en: I stretch my arms every morning after I wake up.
words.example_sk: Každé ráno po zobudení si natiahnem ruky.

words.definition: A person or group that someone is competing against, arguing against, or fighting against.
words.example_en: She defeated her opponent in the final match.
words.example_sk: Vo finálovom zápase porazila svojho protivníka.

words.definition: Physically harmed or hurt.
words.example_en: The injured player was taken to the hospital.
words.example_sk: Zraneného hráča odviezli do nemocnice.

words.definition: To move a ball by bouncing or tapping it repeatedly while moving; also to let saliva or liquid fall in small drops.
words.example_en: She can dribble the ball past two defenders with ease.
words.example_sk: Dokáže driblovať s loptou okolo dvoch obrancov s ľahkosťou.

words.definition: Methods or actions used to achieve a particular result, especially in a planned or strategic way.
words.example_en: The coach changed the team's tactics before the second half.
words.example_sk: Tréner zmenil taktiku tímu pred druhým polčasom.

words.definition: In a gradual, regular, and continuous way without stopping or changing suddenly.
words.example_en: Her English has improved steadily over the past year.
words.example_sk: Jej angličtina sa za posledný rok stabilne zlepšovala.

words.definition: To join in an activity or event.
words.example_en: Many students take part in the school competition every year.
words.example_sk: Mnohí študenti sa každý rok zúčastňujú školskej súťaže.

words.definition: A person who is good at sports and takes part in physical competitions.
words.example_en: She is a talented athlete who trains every day.
words.example_sk: Je talentovaná atlétka, ktorá trénuje každý deň.

words.definition: To become better or to make something better.
words.example_en: She wants to improve her English before the exam.
words.example_sk: Chce si zlepšiť angličtinu pred skúškou.

words.definition: Being in a state where different parts, qualities, or elements are in the correct or equal amounts.
words.example_en: A balanced diet includes fruits, vegetables, and proteins.
words.example_sk: Vyvážená strava zahŕňa ovocie, zeleninu a bielkoviny.

words.definition: Coming at the end of something; the last in a series or process.
words.example_en: This is the final chapter of the book.
words.example_sk: Toto je záverečná kapitola knihy.

words.definition: To use or put one person or thing in the place of another; a person or thing used instead of another.
words.example_en: You can substitute butter with olive oil in this recipe.
words.example_sk: V tomto recepte môžeš nahradiť maslo olivovým olejom.

words.definition: To move past something, to give something to someone, or to succeed in a test; also a document or ticket that allows entry.
words.example_en: Please pass me the salt, and I hope I pass the exam tomorrow.
words.example_sk: Prosím, podaj mi soľ a dúfam, že zajtra spravím skúšku.

words.definition: Able to move quickly and easily; adaptable and responsive to change.
words.example_en: The agile cat jumped onto the fence with ease.
words.example_sk: Obratná mačka vyskočila na plot s ľahkosťou.

words.definition: In a careful and thorough way, or with very little distance or time between things.
words.example_en: Please listen closely to the instructions.
words.example_sk: Prosím, počúvaj pozorne pokyny.

words.definition: To take control or become the person who guides, directs, or is ahead in a situation.
words.example_en: She decided to take the lead in organizing the event.
words.example_sk: Rozhodla sa ujať sa vedenia pri organizovaní podujatia.

words.definition: A group of sports teams or other organizations that compete or work together.
words.example_en: Our team joined the local football league.
words.example_sk: Náš tím vstúpil do miestnej futbalovej ligy.

words.definition: To run very fast for a short distance, or a short race done at top speed.
words.example_en: She had to sprint to catch the bus.
words.example_sk: Musela šprintovať, aby stihla autobus.

words.definition: Difficult to do or deal with; strong and able to endure hardship; hard in texture.
words.example_en: It was a tough decision to make.
words.example_sk: Bolo to ťažké rozhodnutie.

words.definition: In a correct or satisfactory way.
words.example_en: Please make sure the door is properly closed.
words.example_sk: Prosím, uisti sa, že dvere sú správne zatvorené.

words.definition: The team that is playing in its own stadium, field, or area.
words.example_en: The home team scored two goals in the first half.
words.example_sk: Domáci tím strelil v prvom polčase dva góly.
